title: Gluten-Free Mexican Cheese Enchiladas
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican dish with gluten-free tortillas, filled with cheese and a touch of spice, then baked until golden brown.

ingredients.name: Tortillas (corn, gluten-free)
ingredients.notes: Look for gluten-free corn tortillas at your local market.

ingredients.name: Shredded Cheese (cheddar or Monterey Jack)
ingredients.notes: You can also use a blend of cheeses for extra flavor.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef (lean)
ingredients.notes: You can also use shredded chicken or beans for a vegetarian option.

instructions: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon of taco seasoning to the cooked ground beef and stir to combine.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side. This will make them more pliable and easier to roll.
To assemble the enchiladas, lay a tortilla flat and spoon some of the beef mixture onto the center of the tortilla, followed by some shredded cheese.
Roll the tortilla up and place it seam-side down in a baking dish. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
